main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: Free yourself from the illusion of the Demiurge
header_desc: Intertwining 1st-century spirituality with 21st-century physics, this work addresses the fundamental question of our place in the cosmos. The solution to quantum gravity is revealed in two-thousand-year-old texts: the gnostic gospels. The ego possesses mass; therefore, freeing ourselves from it allows us to transcend matter.
left_title: The Pleroma is a flat space-time and the prison a curved one
left_body: Matter tells space-time how to curve, and space-time tells matter how to move. If the ego curves space-time, the temporal plane of the cosmos emerges from our psyche, and the timeless responds to the pneuma. Consciousness oscillates between the states | ONE ⟩ and | EGO ⟩, giving us free will of perception formalized in the inner product ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩. In this context, the premise that the Father and I are one becomes a profound invitation to shed the false self to return to the flat light of the Invisible Father.
universe_light_text: The revelation that the Father is the universe and that death does not exist frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere resides the divine timeless plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (La Patria Grande).
center_text: Free yourself from the illusion of the Demiurge, you sleep in a prison with open doors: the wisdom of Sophia in the right hemisphere versus the ignorance of Yaldabaoth in the left hemisphere reveals the duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere resides the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. Gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: The Christian cross is a key ✝️ to awaken ❤️ from the illusion of time 🧠
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and the spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and the mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and the Illusion of Time (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, the rupture of Einstein's simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The Faggin--Segarra conceptual ensemble: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home, but as a prison for the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas, but to free the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Pleroma of Light and The Material Prison (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The time of no-time and the awakening announced by the Mayan cosmogony. The cosmological question about the origin of Yaldabaoth and the revelation of the Pleroma: the transcendent realm of perfection, silence, and pure light where the Invisible Father dwells, emanated through Sophia (wisdom).
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Brain Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, versus Jesus' revolutionary message that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The central affirmation: I am the way, the truth, and the life; the Father and I are one (John 14:6). The confrontation with the question of questions: Is Jesus God in an immeasurable universe of more than two trillion galaxies? The paradox of the cosmic incarnation on a tiny planet.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a normal-sized white man, bigger than usual, with a flaming beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity.
